name: Paintress
description: Miro-like boards for diagrams (architecture, AWS/GCP, ERD, flowcharts, swimlane process maps) and Markdown+Mermaid docs. A human edits in the browser while LLM agents edit through the REST API; every change shows up live over a WebSocket.

endpoints.name: listBoards
endpoints.description: Lists boards in the caller's workspace (optionally one space). Every workspace member can read and write every board.

endpoints.name: createBoard
endpoints.description: Creates a board. `kind: "diagram"` is a canvas for architecture/AWS/GCP/ERD/flowchart/process diagrams; `kind: "doc"` is a Markdown document whose ```mermaid blocks render as diagrams. `spaceId` defaults to the caller's first space.

endpoints.name: getBoard
endpoints.description: Returns a board with its current content: all items (diagram) or the markdown + version (doc), plus `seq` for resuming live events.

endpoints.name: updateBoard
endpoints.description: Renames a board or changes its description.

endpoints.name: deleteBoard
endpoints.description: Soft-deletes a board.

endpoints.name: listItems
endpoints.description: Lists items of a diagram board. Positions are relative to the parent item (children of groups/lanes move with them). Filter with `type` (shape|group|pool|lane|entity|edge|sticky|text|image) or `parentId`.

endpoints.name: applyOps
endpoints.description: Applies a batch of create/update/delete ops in ONE transaction = ONE undo step for the human (`label` is shown to them, e.g. "AI: added API gateway"). Deleting an item also deletes its children and attached edges. Returns the new state of touched items and `inverse` ops that revert the batch. Ops that cannot apply (missing id, version conflict, duplicate key) are reported in `skipped` and the rest still apply.

endpoints.name: createItems
endpoints.description: Convenience wrapper over /ops: creates items. Item `data` depends on `type` — shape {pack,shape,text,icon,…}, group {kind,title,…}, entity {name,columns[]}, edge {from:{itemId,handle?},to:{…},label,kind,cardinality}, sticky {text,color}, text {text}. See GET /catalog for shapes, group kinds and icons.

endpoints.name: patchItem
endpoints.description: Updates one item. `data` is shallow-merged (a null value removes a key). Pass `ifVersion` to guard against concurrent edits.

endpoints.name: deleteItem
endpoints.description: Deletes one item together with its children and attached edges.

endpoints.name: getEvents
endpoints.description: Change log of a board (who changed what, with inverse ops). `since` returns events with seq greater than it. The same events stream live over the WebSocket.

endpoints.name: undoBatch
endpoints.description: Reverts one past batch by applying its stored inverse ops (itself a new, undoable batch). Items edited since may make parts of the undo `skipped`.

endpoints.name: buildDiagram
endpoints.description: PRIMARY AGENT ENDPOINT for architecture, cloud (AWS/GCP), C4 and flowchart diagrams. Describe the graph — nested `groups` (style ids like aws-cloud, aws-vpc, aws-subnet-private, gcp-project, boundary), `nodes` (label, icon id or phrase, shape) and `edges` (label, step, kind sync|async|data) — and the server computes positions (ELK layered layout, orthogonal edges, nested containers). Items are matched by `key`, so calling again with mode=merge updates/extends the diagram without disturbing parts the human moved by hand. mode=replace wipes the board first.

mode.description: merge: create or update items by key. replace: wipe the board first.

label.description: Undo-step label shown to the human

relayout.description: Also move items the human has positioned by hand

icon.description: Icon id ("logos:aws-lambda") or a phrase ("aws lambda") that is resolved for you

inverse.description: Ops that revert this batch (what the human's Undo applies)

endpoints.name: buildErd
endpoints.description: Builds an entity-relationship diagram: `entities` with typed `columns` (pk, fk:"entity.column", nullable, unique). Relations are derived from column `fk`s (crow's-foot cardinality inferred from nullable/unique) and can be added explicitly. Each column is its own connection point, so relation lines attach to the exact row.

mode.description: merge: create or update items by key. replace: wipe the board first.

relations.description: Extra relations; column `fk` references are turned into relations automatically

inverse.description: Ops that revert this batch (what the human's Undo applies)

endpoints.name: buildProcess
endpoints.description: Builds a swimlane process map: `lanes`, `steps` (each in a lane, with a flowchart/BPMN shape such as process, decision, terminator, task, start-event, gateway-exclusive) and `flows` between steps. Steps are layered left→right in flow order, inside their lane.

mode.description: merge: create or update items by key. replace: wipe the board first.

shape.description: Flowchart or BPMN shape id: process, decision, terminator, task, start-event, end-event, gateway-exclusive, …

inverse.description: Ops that revert this batch (what the human's Undo applies)

endpoints.name: importMermaid
endpoints.description: Imports Mermaid source as native, editable items. Supported: `flowchart`/`graph` (shapes, subgraphs, edge labels, dashed/bidirectional links) and `erDiagram`. Other Mermaid types are rejected — use /diagram, or write them into a doc board where ```mermaid blocks render as-is.

mode.description: merge: create or update items by key. replace: wipe the board first.

inverse.description: Ops that revert this batch (what the human's Undo applies)

endpoints.name: relayout
endpoints.description: Tidy up: re-runs auto-layout over the whole board, or over the children of `groupId`. Hand-placed (pinned) items are kept unless `includePinned`. Swimlane pools are left alone.

groupId.description: Only re-layout the children of this group

inverse.description: Ops that revert this batch (what the human's Undo applies)

endpoints.name: describeBoard
endpoints.description: Compact text outline of a board — groups as a tree, nodes with icons, ERD tables, lanes and connections written as `a --label--> b` — so an agent can read back what is there. Doc boards return their markdown.

endpoints.name: getDoc
endpoints.description: Returns a doc board's markdown and version.

endpoints.name: putDoc
endpoints.description: Replaces a doc board's markdown. Pass `ifVersion` to fail with 409 if someone edited since you read it.

endpoints.name: patchDoc
endpoints.description: Edits a doc board in place without resending it: `append`/`prepend`, `replace_section` (by heading text; replaces everything up to the next heading of the same or higher level) or `replace` (find → with). Ops apply in order, atomically.

markdown.description: New section body; the heading line is kept

endpoints.name: searchIcons
endpoints.description: Searches the bundled icon sets: `logos` (tech brands + AWS services, e.g. logos:aws-lambda), `gcp` (Google Cloud products, e.g. gcp:bigquery), `carbon` (generic infrastructure) and `mdi`. Use the returned `id` as a node's `icon`.

endpoints.name: getIcon
endpoints.description: Serves one icon as an SVG image (`image/svg+xml`). Optional `color` recolours monochrome icons.

endpoints.name: getCatalog
endpoints.description: Everything a client needs to build diagrams: shape packs and shape ids, group styles (AWS/GCP/C4), edge kinds, cardinalities and icon sets.

endpoints.name: uploadAsset
endpoints.description: Uploads an image (multipart/form-data, field `file`, png/jpeg/gif/webp/svg, ≤10 MB) to the board's S3 folder (paintress/{workspaceId}/{boardId}/{assetId}). Place it with an `image` item {assetId}.

endpoints.name: getAsset
endpoints.description: Serves an uploaded image (workspace-checked). Streams the bytes.
